topic.readerProblem: Resolve conflicting public Profound price configurations before budgeting an AI-search visibility monitoring program.
topic.connection: Directly supports an AEOeye buyer choosing how to measure recurring brand visibility across answer engines.

assessment: The final guide uses the current official self-serve plan cards: Starter US$99 and Growth US$399 per month, both billed yearly, with Enterprise custom. It separates prompt, engine and Agents-credit limits, and labels the US$3,990 calculation as a pre-tax planning total rather than a checkout invoice.

sources.supports: Current official Starter, Growth and Enterprise prices, billing basis, prompt limits, engine coverage, Agents credits and Growth trial action.

checks: Opened every named official source and compared the visible price, currency, billing basis and allowances with the final article.
Recomputed the worked example from the published inputs and checked that caveats remain adjacent to the arithmetic.
Read the final opening, plan table, limitations, internal links and all four FAQs for consistency and documentation-only disclosure.
Confirmed the article makes no paid-account, accuracy, output-quality or hands-on performance claim.

pricing.region: US / USD public references; regional tax and checkout terms can differ
pricing.billing: Starter and Growth display monthly equivalents billed yearly; Growth advertises two months free. Enterprise is custom-priced.
pricing.verification: Checked the live official pricing page: Starter US$99 monthly billed yearly with 50 prompts and one engine; Growth US$399 monthly billed yearly with 100 prompts and three engines. Recomputed Growth as US$399 × 10 = US$3,990 before tax.
